sources.snippet: coa-mapper-mcp is an open-source Model Context Protocol server that lets AI assistants map, compare, and validate charts of accounts across popular small-business accounting platforms. It ships with curated account data for five platforms and a GAAP reference layer so mappings are grounded in standard accounting taxonomy.
